question:
(a) Compare metals, semiconductors and insulators on the basis of resistivity.
(b) Explain why copper is used for connecting wires while nichrome is used for resistance wires.
(c) Arrange metals, semiconductors and insulators in increasing order of resistivity.

options.A:
(a) Metals have highest resistivity, semiconductors intermediate, and insulators lowest.
(b) Copper is used for resistance wires because of high resistivity; nichrome is used for connecting wires because of low resistivity.
(c) Increasing order: insulators $<$ semiconductors $<$ metals.
options.B:
(a) Metals, semiconductors and insulators have equal resistivity.
(b) Copper and nichrome are interchangeable because resistivity does not matter.
(c) All have the same resistivity.
options.C:
(a) Metals have low resistivity, semiconductors intermediate resistivity, and insulators high resistivity.
(b) Copper is used for connecting wires because its low resistivity reduces heating and energy loss; nichrome is used for resistance wires because its high resistivity provides appreciable resistance.
(c) Increasing order: metals $<$ semiconductors $<$ insulators.
options.D:
(a) Semiconductors have lowest resistivity and metals highest.
(b) Copper is used for heating elements because it has high resistivity.
(c) Increasing order: semiconductors $<$ insulators $<$ metals.
